name: Fall 2019 Camping Trip
description: A time of fellowship and fun in the forest! There will be multiple optional hikes and plenty of opportunities for bonding. This is a time to introduce new members to our community and for returning members to enjoy each other's company. This year we will be going to Mt. Mitchell state park and spending two nights. Details will be discussed at our first meeting on Wednesday, Sept. 4th, and will be later reiterated via email and groupme. We will take multiple 15-passenger vans, but other carpooling will also be arranged via groupme.
